templates.title: Transcribe speech
templates.description: Pinned local WAV and model to checked transcript and captions; replace paths and model hash. Output needs human review.

templates.title: Correct a transcript draft (host-only)
templates.description: Pin a retained machine segments.json and replace cue text with a declared review status and note; replace the path, digest and edits. The status is your declaration, not verified.

review.note: Describe what was reviewed and against what.

templates.title: Delete cues from a transcript draft (host-only)
templates.description: Pin a retained machine segments.json and delete whole cues by source index, optionally replacing others; replace the path, digest, indices and note. The status is your declaration, not verified; deleting every cue publishes an empty transcript.

review.note: Describe what was reviewed and why the cue was removed.

templates.title: Retime cues of a transcript draft (host-only)
templates.description: Pin a retained machine segments.json and state new start and end times for cues by source index, optionally replacing or deleting others; replace the path, digest, indices, times and note. The status and the times are your declaration, not verified against the audio.

review.note: Describe what was reviewed and why the times were changed.

templates.title: Lay out caption lines (host-only)
templates.description: Pin a retained timed transcript and break each cue into explicit SRT and WebVTT lines at word boundaries; replace the path and digest and choose the bounds. Words and times are unchanged, a longer unbreakable run or too many lines is refused, and the source status is carried unchanged, not verified.
